en: Sepia-toned vintage waterfront view showing a long seaside promenade lined with multi‑story buildings on the right and a harbor with sailing vessels and small boats on the left. The scene is captured from an elevated perspective along the coast. Handwritten Greek text appears along the bottom edge of the image, and a modern printed watermark with a website URL is overlaid near the lower right.
